closeout_rule: PROTOCOL_FORK_TRUTH_CLOSED may be issued only when every required gate is PASS on exact content-addressed source, all historical fixtures are block-hash pinned, and OPEN unexplained parity mismatches and OPEN hard source blockers are both zero.

measured_compatibility_repairs.defect: Alloy 2.5.0 ABI uint40 values are Uint<40,1>, while recovered snapshot fields are u64.
measured_compatibility_repairs.repair: Explicit lossless Uint<40,1> to u64 conversion on last_update_timestamp and liquidation_grace_period_until.
measured_compatibility_repairs.semantic_rationale: Every uint40 value is exactly representable in u64; no truncation, rounding, unit conversion, branch, address, protocol constant, or authority semantics change.

measured_compatibility_repairs.defect: Alloy 2.5.0 decodes the named single uint256 execute return directly as U256; recovered code incorrectly dereferenced it as a generated return struct.
measured_compatibility_repairs.repair: Return the validated ABI-decoded U256 directly.
measured_compatibility_repairs.semantic_rationale: ABI bytes and uint256 value are unchanged; only the generated Rust return-shape assumption is corrected.

measured_compatibility_repairs.defect: Recovered nqc-aave-sync unit tests import nqc_core::{ray,wad} without declaring nqc-core as a dev-dependency.
measured_compatibility_repairs.repair: Add nqc-core path dependency under dev-dependencies only.
measured_compatibility_repairs.semantic_rationale: Production dependency graph and runtime code are unchanged; this only makes the already-authored historical tests physically compilable.

measured_compatibility_repairs.defect: Recovered nqc-aave-math unit tests call nqc_core::wad() without importing it into the test module.
measured_compatibility_repairs.repair: Import nqc_core::wad inside the cfg(test) module only.
measured_compatibility_repairs.semantic_rationale: Production code is unchanged; this only resolves the already-authored historical test helper symbol.

measured_compatibility_repairs.defect: Recovered nqc-aave-opportunity unit tests import nqc_aave_sync::ReserveConfigurationBits without declaring nqc-aave-sync as a dev-dependency.
measured_compatibility_repairs.repair: Add nqc-aave-sync path dependency under dev-dependencies only.
measured_compatibility_repairs.semantic_rationale: Production runtime dependencies and opportunity logic are unchanged; this only makes the existing historical test module link against its referenced test helper crate.

measured_compatibility_repairs.defect: Recovered REVM 43.0.2 integration calls BlockEnv::set_blob_excess_gas_and_price with the obsolete one-argument shape; the pinned API requires the spec-aware blob base-fee update fraction explicitly.
measured_compatibility_repairs.repair: Pass the EIP-4844 base-fee update fraction selected from the pinned SpecId: Cancun fraction before Prague, Prague fraction from Prague onward.
measured_compatibility_repairs.semantic_rationale: This restores the intended spec-aware blob gas price derivation using REVM's own pinned EIP-4844 constants; no block identity, transaction, state, authority, or economic acceptance rule changes.

measured_compatibility_repairs.defect: Pinned solc 0.8.24 legacy codegen fails Stack too deep at the LiquidationExecuted emission (job 108557144387).
measured_compatibility_repairs.repair: Extract the unchanged repayment validation, approval and event emission into a private helper receiving CallbackContext, amount and premium.
measured_compatibility_repairs.semantic_rationale: Same checked arithmetic, revert payloads, approval order and event arguments; no external call added, no compiler/profile change. New deployed bytecode must be rebound and fork-certified.
